title: 94th Annual Candlelight Musical Service
seo_title: 94th Annual Candlelight Musical Service in Springfield, MO
description: The 94th Annual Candlelight Musical Service is an evening of worship, candlelight, and song at First & Calvary Presbyterian Church, with choirs, instrumentalists, and friends of the church. The service weaves together Scripture, prayer, and a variety of musical styles centered on the story of Christ's birth. It takes place Sunday, December 6, 2026 at 6:30 PM at 820 E Cherry St in Springfield, MO.
